chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from a man, from Yahya al-Azraq who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The swishing of the wings of the pigeons expels the satans.'

key_terms.حَفِيف: The soft sound or rustling of wings

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of keeping pigeons at home according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the metaphysical efficacy of pigeons, noting that the gentle rustling of their wings (*hufif ajnihah al-hamam*) serves to repel devils. This narration underscores the traditional Shia belief in the spiritual purity of domestic animals and their role in maintaining a sanctified household environment against unseen forces.

en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from a man, from Yahya Al Azraq who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The swishing of the wings of the pigeons expels the satans<sup>la</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 11. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Ali from a man from Yahya al-Arzaq who has said the following:
I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘The sound of the wings of pigeon dispels the devils.’”
